config.notes: UNE course pages (www.une.edu.au/study/courses/<slug>) print one Start Dates and Campus table header (Trimester 1 - February, Trimester 2 - June, Trimester 3 - October of the current year) followed by two sets of rows: domestic (Online, Armidale Campus, Sydney Campus) then international (Online, Armidale Campus, Sydney Campus). Intakes = trimester months Offered in any INTERNATIONAL campus row (online excluded: not available on a student visa). Courses whose international campus rows are all Not Offered are online-only for international students and get no adapter intakes. Fee = the international "Estimated fees for your first year" figure marked * (annual); the # figure is the reduced online-only international fee and is skipped. For courses of 0.5 years or 1 trimester the first-year figure is the whole-course amount (exclude). Central fee lists (www.une.edu.au/international/fees-and-scholarships/course-fees-2026 and -2027) are read per CRICOS code ("CRICOS <code> Fee 34,800*"); the 2027 list gives 2027 fees. IELTS is not on course pages: central rule at https://www.une.edu.au/international/apply/eligibility/english-language-requirements (IELTS 6.0, no band below 5.5) with higher requirements in https://policies.une.edu.au/document/view-current.php?id=221. Key dates: https://www.une.edu.au/about-une/principal-dates (2026: T1 23 Feb, T2 22 Jun, T3 19 Oct) and /principal-dates-2027 (T1 22 Feb, T2 21 Jun, T3 18 Oct).
